options.name: Entertainer Island

violations.message: Two work zones are far apart — expect extra walking

options.rationale: A warm timber kitchen with clean contemporary lines. The sink and dishwasher sit together on the plumbing wall, while the cooktop has useful bench space on both sides. The island adds generous prep room and relaxed seating for entertaining, with tall storage grouped to one side.

options.name: Everyday Work Triangle

violations.message: Two work zones are far apart — expect extra walking

options.rationale: This layout keeps the main cooking, washing and food storage zones close together for an easy everyday rhythm. The sink remains on the existing plumbing wall with the dishwasher alongside, while the cooktop is framed by bench space. Natural oak cabinetry, white tops and slim silver lip pulls keep the look warm and quietly contemporary.

options.name: Storage & Social Hub

violations.message: Two work zones are far apart — expect extra walking

options.rationale: Designed for hosting, this option makes the large island the social heart of the kitchen, with seating and storage facing the room. The sink and dishwasher remain together on the plumbing wall, and the cooktop has clear bench space to either side. Tall pantry storage and the fridge are kept to the side so guests can gather without interrupting cooking.

syntheticReactions: I can see how the room questions shape the result, but I want clearer guidance when my measurements are only approximate.
The three-option result is useful because I can compare layout priorities instead of starting from a blank 3D canvas.
The shown band of $39,000–$49,500 feels indicative; inclusion and GST labels will decide whether I trust it.
